decisions.reason: The custom-furniture carpentry uses the sheltered workshop's existing production know-how at low incremental cost and gives participants meaningful work, so no shortfall against aspirations calls for search.

Outpatient sociotherapy complements the psychiatric offer, and the expanding firm's slack lets it carry the service despite staffing and financing uncertainty, especially after the evening day-patient program was already cut.
Senior-living counseling remains a prominent feeder into the core eldercare business and clearly meets management's aspirations.
The workshop retail shop still has uncertain results, but it supports sales and visibility of the workshop products, and slack from expansion allows it to continue.

Senior meal delivery is a recently launched service close to the core eldercare offer that uses existing kitchen and logistics capacity, so its early, uncertain results are tolerated with available slack.
